Messages.Author: stubby
Messages.Body:
during our game last night a couple of questions came up and
especially as we've got a newbie, we'd like to get some clarification.

1) calling a vote. when do you replace the actual vote card?
a) immediately ie as you play the card
B) after blocking is declined
c) after voting ie after the action

2) action modifiers on a vote. when do you replace them?
a) immediately ie as you play the card
B) after blocking is declined
c) after voting ie after the action

3)contesting a title. who pays for the contest?
a) the vampire
b) from pool

and is just the title is contested ie unuseable title but vampires are
still useable?

Messages.Author: Sorrow
Messages.Body:
> 1) calling a vote. when do you replace the actual vote card?

Immediately after you play the vote card

> 2) action modifiers on a vote. when do you replace them?

After the referrendum is complete (ie, after all voting has occured
and the text of the PA has been fulfillled)

> 3)contesting a title. who pays for the contest?

The vampire

> and is just the title is contested ie unuseable title but vampires are
> still useable?

Correct. Anything in contention is not in play. In the case of titles,
the affected vamps cannot use that title to gain votes but other
than that, the vamp is perfectly usable.

Sorrow
